items.question: Which WNBA teams did Erica McCall play for?
items.answer: The Indiana Fever drafted Erica McCall 17th overall in 2017. She played for Indiana (2017 to 2019), Atlanta and Minnesota (2020) and the Washington Mystics (2021).

items.question: Where did Erica McCall play college basketball?
items.answer: Erica McCall played at Stanford from 2013 to 2017. She made the All-Pac-12 team twice and helped the Cardinal reach two Final Fours. She returned to Stanford as an assistant coach in July 2023.

items.question: What did Erica McCall average in the WNBA?
items.answer: Erica McCall averaged 2.9 points and 2.8 rebounds in 122 WNBA regular-season games from 2017 to 2021.
